title: AE Sales Ride-Along Observation Workbook
description: Field observation workbook for Associate Account Executives riding along with an experienced Sales Representative. Complete the pre-call preparation observations, then an interview/observation sheet for each sales appointment.
author: Johnson Controls ASCEND Learning

questions.helpText: Name of the experienced Sales Representative you rode along with.

questions.prompt: Number of appointments scheduled for the day
questions.helpText: Depending on the length of the appointments you may observe one or more calls.

questions.prompt: How does the Sales Rep qualify the opportunity?
How did the Sales Rep prepare the agenda and objectives for the call?
What does the Sales Rep bring along for the meeting?
questions.helpText: For example, marketing collateral, data on existing systems, or a security review form.

questions.prompt: Where does the Sales Rep secure the materials needed?
Did you arrive at the appointment on time?
How did the Sales Rep begin the conversation with the customer?
What techniques did this rep use that you will use to establish contact and credibility with the commercial customer?
During the appointment, did the Sales Rep follow the solution selling process?
What techniques did you observe on the part of the Sales Rep that indicated attention to and concern for the customer’s property and peace of mind?
Based on your experience today, what do you see as the greatest challenge in managing the sales call?
What did you learn during this appointment that will be useful to you when you are on a sales call?
